scenario_config.prompt: I need to reorganize my calendar. First, please update the 'Project Management' calendar's title to 'Study Calendar'. Next, remove all the events from the calendar. Lastly, please let me know which settings are enabled.

verifier_configs.name: Change title
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT count(*) FROM calendars WHERE summary = 'Study Calendar'

verifier_configs.name: Clear calendar
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT calendar_id FROM calendars WHERE summary = 'Study Calendar') AS sub WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE event_id = 'event-corrected-001')
